* **Subscriptions & Streaming:** Review existing active subscriptions (such as your $15/month streaming plan) and cancel any unused services or rotate subscriptions.

* **YNAB / Detailed Expense Tracking:** Continue logging and categorizing all variable expenses to catch budget leaks early.
